findings.title: Fallback catalogs are only eagerly loaded for controller requests
findings.body: The fallback locale files are loaded only through `ApplicationController#set_locale`, while the translation accelerator automatically loads only `I18n.config.locale` during a normal `I18n.t` call. The Fallbacks backend subsequently reads the default/en locale catalog directly; it does not invoke the patched top-level translator for each fallback locale. Consequently mailers, background jobs, rake tasks, model code, and any boot-time translation that run outside an ApplicationController can report a missing translation even when it exists in the configured fallback locale. Ensure fallback locales are loaded as part of the generic translation/fallback lookup path rather than relying on the controller filter.
